sources.finding: Firecracker microVM per agent in a separate AWS account; workspace recycled after idle; snapshots kept rolling 90 days inactive; conversation state kept indefinitely unless deleted via API; Privacy Mode (not Legacy); commands auto-run; draft PRs; HSM-signed commits; SOC 2 Type 2 statement; region not stated.

sources.finding: Three egress modes (allow all, default + allowlist, allowlist only); internet on by default; Enterprise can lock policy; runtime secrets redacted in transcripts and commits.

sources.finding: Tool execution on own machine while agent loop and inference stay in Cursor cloud; Team Pools need Enterprise; up to 200 workers per user and 1,000 per team; outbound HTTPS only; partner hosts such as AWS Lambda, Modal, Vercel; user pays for own infrastructure.
